verdict.rationale: Temporal's AI material covers using it as infrastructure to build durable LLM agents: agent loops, the OpenAI Agents SDK integration, and cookbook recipes. Those are developer building blocks, not an in-product feature that generates insights or suggestions from the user's data. The Web UI is documented only as showing Workflow Execution state and metadata for debugging, with no AI-generated insights mentioned.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
